leads.title: Constitution of Ukraine, Article 51 (1996)
leads.documents: Defines marriage as a voluntary union between a man and a woman; bars legal recognition of same-sex marriage.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Article 51 of the Constitution, adopted in 1996'

leads.title: Family Code of Ukraine, Clause 211
leads.documents: Explicitly bans same-sex couples from adoption; single people regardless of sexual orientation allowed to adopt; only registered different-sex married couples allowed as foreign adopters.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Clause 211 of Family Code of Ukraine'

leads.title: Ukraine Labor Code Amendment of 12 November 2015
leads.documents: Bans sexual orientation and gender identity discrimination at work; described as EU requirement for visa-free travel to Schengen Area.
leads.detail: Passed 12 November 2015 after failed votes 5 and 9 November 2015; Speaker Volodymyr Groysman cited

leads.title: Media Regulation Bill, December 2022 / EU Audiovisual Media Services Directive
leads.documents: Unanimously passed bill banning hate speech and discrimination against LGBTQ people in mass media; alignment with EU candidacy requirement.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Directive (EU) 2018/1808' - Audiovisual Media Services Directive

leads.title: Istanbul Convention ratification by Verkhovna Rada
leads.documents: Ratification of Council of Europe domestic violence treaty despite opposition citing sexual orientation/gender references; vote and entry into force dates.
leads.detail: Bill registered 18 June 2022 by President Zelenskyy; supported 20 June 2022 by 259 votes against 8; instrument submitted 18 July 2022; entered into force 1 November 2022

leads.title: Cabinet of Ministers Rule of Law Roadmap for EU accession, 14 May 2025
leads.documents: Government roadmap p.3.11 envisaging law on registered partnerships (Q3 2025) and hate-crime reforms (Q2 2026) adding sexual orientation/gender identity as aggravating circumstance, administrative liability, public incitement liability, free legal aid.
leads.detail: Adopted and approved 14 May 2025; p.3.11 on discrimination against LGBTIQ community

leads.title: Desnianskyi District Court decision of 10 June 2025
leads.documents: First Ukrainian decision recognizing 'existence of actual marital relations' between two Ukrainian men.

leads.title: Supreme Court in Kyiv ruling, March 2026
leads.documents: Rejected challenge to lower-court ruling that recognized same-sex couples as de facto family.
leads.detail: Dated March 2026, Supreme Court in Kyiv

leads.title: Ukrainian Civil Code (2011 amendment) and 2016 transgender procedure reform + August 2016 ruling
leads.documents: Allows transgender people who underwent surgery to change name; since Dec 2016 new IDs issued before surgery per Aug 2016 ruling ordering passport/document changes without surgery; removes 30-day psychiatric hospital and special commission permission requirements.
leads.detail: 2011 Civil Code amendment; August 2016 ruling for two transgender people; new procedure since December 2016; prior requirement: age 25+, special commission of Ministry of Healthcare, transsexuality diagnosis

leads.title: Criminal Code of Ukraine hate-crime provisions and April 2020 draft amendment
leads.documents: Documents gap: harsher penalties only for racial, national, religious intolerance, not sexual orientation/gender identity; draft to add SOGI withdrawn Sept 2020 after Committee on Law Enforcement conclusion.
leads.detail: Draft introduced April 2020, withdrawn September 2020; cited absence of terms 'gender identity,' 'sexual orientation' in legislation
